bibl.title: Purple and its Various Kinds in Documentary Papyri.
bibl.seg: Ines Bogensperger, Purple and its Various Kinds in Documentary Papyri.

Salvatore Gaspa, Cécile Michel & Marie-Louise Nosch (edd.), Textile Terminologies from the Orient to the Mediterranean and Europe, 1000 BC to 1000 AD = Zea E-Books. 56 (Lincoln, NE, 2017) pp. 235-249, figg.
bibl.note: True and false purple. - Sea-purple. - Common purple. - Rose-coloured and splendid bright purple. - Purple from specific origin and local purple. - Further terms with the meaning "purple": Blatta-purple; - Ostrum resp. ὄστρεον and conchylia; - Hysginum and madder: purple from plant dyestuffs. - Conclusion.
